description: Read the included website and private PostgreSQL slots for your account. These are separate from pilot VMs and paid VMs. All three plans include at most one of each. Free without a verified card lasts seven days. Capacity is limited: reserved requests with free_capacity_wait are queued in eligible request order and resume automatically. Keep the same request and operation ID; there is no guaranteed start time, and the seven-day clock continues. Use these operation IDs to manage or delete included VMs; do not search the paid VM list.
name: get_free_resources
